satirical_subtitle: A semi-permanent traveling circus that has not traveled since 1997

time_restrictions.note: Grounds open 14:00-01:00 daily, crossing midnight. Individual stitched sub-locations keep their own posted hours where already established (prize_booth: 'whenever the circus is open'); this window is authoritative for the grounds as a whole, per cirque_du_shady.md Access & Requirements.

special_conditions.filming_day_hamstradamus_absence: On Beatdown filming days (filming_day_active == true), Hamstradamus is physically absent from prophecy_tent, relocated to Fauxst Beach as prize-giver per hamstradamus.md
special_conditions.filming_day_gear_traffic: shady_productions_office and the riverside gear path see increased foot traffic toward the Bohemian Riviera on filming days
special_conditions.beatdown_aware_trigger: Set on first examination of the shady_productions_office folding table/fax machine, or on hearing Vance mention 'the show'
special_conditions.vance_met_trigger: Set on first dialogue with Ringmaster Vance
special_conditions.cirque_visited_trigger: Set on first entry to the grounds via either gate

buffoon_delusion.what_bros_think: They have discovered the real, functioning nerve center of an international entertainment operation - a circus that's secretly a media empire, and they, specifically, are the kind of guys a media empire would want.
buffoon_delusion.what_actually_happens: A rigged game alley, a garbage-prize booth, a food cart of questionable provenance, a prophet nobody believes despite being always right, a failed street performer busking for tips, a knife act older than most of the tourists, and a fax machine that has printed the same flyer for twenty-two seasons, all operating under one canvas dome that has not moved since before most of them could drive.

performance.note: Nine active zones stitched into one grounds (main_gate, big_top, prophecy_tent, game_alley, prize_booth, meat_cart_pitch, performance_circle, shady_productions_office, icq_backroom); individual stitched sub-locations retain their own already-specified performance budgets, per cirque_du_shady.md Technical Requirements.
